headline: Within-cohort F_ROH–realized-load association has a CI above zero in 15/15 primary cells and 15/15 cells after the generic-homozygosity control.
uncertainty: 95% cohort-stratified bootstrap intervals; 1,999 within-cohort permutations per outcome/cell
unit: of 15 partial realized-load cells with CI low > 0
what_changes_mind: At least 12/15 partial realized-load CIs entirely above zero.
scientific_boundary: Association among genomic proxies; no fitness, depression, or causal effect is measured.

headline: 1/4 diversity metrics retain a museum-higher direction through every damage and individual-influence check; geographic mismatch still blocks a temporal-erosion claim.
uncertainty: 95% 5-Mb chromosome-block bootstrap; exact label p-value range 0.3312–0.8312
unit: of 4 metrics concordant through every numerical stress test
what_changes_mind: 4/4 metrics must pass every numerical stress test and time must be separated from geography by design.
scientific_boundary: Deposited groups differ in geography as well as period; diversity is not fitness.

headline: 0/15 simulated sample-size/marker designs meet the predeclared two-sided decision-resolution rule; empirical downsampling is reported separately.
uncertainty: 95% Wilson intervals on replicate rates; currentNe2 90% estimator intervals retained per attempt
result_filter: scenario true_ne in {250,1000}; empirical rows remain truth=unknown
change_threshold: correct CI low >= 0.70; incorrect CI high <= 0.25
unit: of 15 design combinations resolving both true Ne=250 and 1,000
what_changes_mind: For both predeclared resolution truths (Ne=250 and 1,000), correct-confident Wilson lower >= 0.70 and incorrect-confident Wilson upper <= 0.25.
scientific_boundary: Neutral scenarios calibrate this pipeline; they cannot guarantee an exact real sampling outcome.

headline: ROH-localized burden decision: IMPLEMENT.
estimate: 15/15 partial coefficients positive; 15/15 have CI low > 0
uncertainty: Gate inherits the 15 cohort-bootstrap intervals from Section 13.1.
what_changes_mind: At least 12/15 prespecified partial realized-load associations must be positive with cohort-bootstrap CI entirely above zero.
scientific_boundary: Localization would be mechanistic support between genomic proxies, not fitness, inbreeding depression, or causation.

headline: At the predeclared 1.5 Mb cutoff, observed realized-burden enrichment exceeds the circular-shift null upper bound with two-sided permutation p <= 0.05 in 24/24 population-by-GERP cells.
uncertainty: 95% interval from 199 within-chromosome circular-shift replicates per cell; two-sided plus-one permutation p-values.
result_filter: roh_cutoff_mb=1.5; each of 8 populations x GERP>{2,3,4} counted only when log2_enrichment>null_ci_high and permutation_p_two_sided<=0.05
change_threshold: log2 enrichment > null 95% upper bound and two-sided p <= 0.05
unit: of 24 predeclared population-by-GERP cells beyond the circular-shift null
what_changes_mind: A cell changes classification only if its observed log2 enrichment crosses the circular-shift upper bound or its two-sided permutation p-value crosses 0.05.
scientific_boundary: This spatial co-localization of genomic proxies provides mechanistic support, not a demonstrated biological mechanism. The denominator is eligible calls at assayed SNP records rather than callable genomic bases, so ascertainment remains. It is not fitness evidence, not evidence of phenotypic consequences, and not causal evidence.

headline: Independent annotation triangulation decision: DEFER_DUPLICATES_SOURCE_STUDY.
estimate: Local autosomal VEP/SIFT class counts exactly match the source analysis; common sample intersection is 211/211. The source already compares VEP/SIFT, genome-wide GERP, and their source-labeled SIFT-'deleterious' intersection.
uncertainty: Exact deposited class inventory and common-sample coverage, not an estimated effect.
what_changes_mind: At least 1 annotation definition independent of the deposited source classes, with >=0.95 common-sample coverage and >=0.90 auditable callable-denominator coverage.
scientific_boundary: Predicted-impact classes remain separate risk proxies; they are not proven harmful variants.
